entries.name: User caches
entries.hint: Application caches for the current user. They speed up loading.
entries.impact: Apps rebuild these; the first launch after cleaning is slower.

entries.name: User logs
entries.hint: Log files written by applications, used for debugging.
entries.impact: Apps start a new log file on their next run.

entries.name: Trash
entries.hint: Items already in the Trash. Their space is only freed when the Trash is emptied.
